items.title: 8.13 The effect of change in pressure or volume (pressure ya volume badalne ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.13, printed pages 180-181, with the first Quick Check 8.6.

blocks.text: Volume ya pressure badalne ka asar in cases (soorton) mein nahi hota:

items: Jab system mein koi gas shamil na ho.
Jab gas phase ke homogeneous equilibrium mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon.

blocks.text: Yeh asar sirf tab hota hai jab reactants aur products ki gas ke moles barabar na hon.
Is asar ko samajhne ke liye Haber process se ammonia banana dekhein.
